product: Query tags for SQL warehouses are now generally available
tagline: Query tags are now generally available.
what_it_does: Query tags are now generally available. You can apply custom key value tags to SQL workloads for grouping, filtering, and cost attribution on Databricks SQL warehouses and Lakehouse//RT compute. Tags appear in system.query.history and on the Query History page of the Databricks UI.
why_it_matters: You can apply custom key value tags to SQL workloads for grouping, filtering, and cost attribution on Databricks SQL warehouses and Lakehouse//RT compute.
